evidence_quote: Andrew invites two more friends, so he asks for 6 donuts for each of them.
question_evidence_quote: A day before the sleepover Andrew ends up inviting two more friends and asks his mother to buy them the same amount of donuts.
observed_error: The response assigns 6 donuts to each new friend instead of 3.
violated_condition: Each newly invited friend receives the same initial 3 donuts as Brian and Samuel.
error_description: The response assigns 6 donuts to each newly invited friend, although the same amount refers to the 3 donuts requested for each original friend. Its addition of 6 + 6 is correct arithmetic, but the per-person quantity violates the equal-allocation condition.
secondary_errors: The response adds only 1 extra donut, although the mother requests one extra for each of four friends.
The final total adds only 1 donut for Andrew, violating the requirement that he receive the same amount as each friend.
